texts.preamble: Saleem Mainuddin Shaikh vs State Of Maharashtra on 31 August, 2023 Author: M. S. Karnik Bench: M. S. Karnik 2023:Bhc-As:25036 Pmb 909.ba.1976-23.doc In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Bail Application No.1976 Of 2023 Saleem Mainuddin Shaikh ..Applicant Vs. The State Of Maharashtra ..Respondent ------------ Mr. Sachin M. Bhavar for the Applicant. Ms. Veera Shinde, App for the State. Api Dhanraj Kedar, Bhiwandi Crime Branch, Thane. ------------ Coram : M. S. Karnik, J. Date : August 31, 2023 P.C. : 1. 2. This is an application for bail in respect of the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code (hereafter 'Ipc' for short) and under Sections 26(2), 27, 23, 26(2)(iv), 30(2)(a), 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act registered vide C.R. No.333 of 2022 with Kongaon Police Station, Thane. 3. The FIR was registered on 31.12.2022.
texts.facts: 2. This is an application for bail in respect of the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code (hereafter 'Ipc' for short) and under Sections 26(2), 27, 23, 26(2)(iv), 30(2)(a), 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act registered vide C.R. No.333 of 2022 with Kongaon Police Station, Thane. 3. The FIR was registered on 31.12.2022. The applicant Saleem Mainuddin Shaikh vs State Of Maharashtra on 31 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23537342/ 1 was arrested on 14.06.2023. The applicant is the accused 1/3 PMB 909.ba.1976-23.doc No.2. There are in all four accused. The car in which the 'gutkha' was found in respect of which it is alleged that the aforesaid offence is committed is owned by the present applicant. The 'gutkha' worth Rs.32,88,600/- was seized. The said product according to the prosecution is banned. The recovery is from the co-accused.
texts.arguments: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the issue as to whether the offence punishable under Section 328 of the IPC will be applicable to the product 'gutkha' is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court. The entire material has been recovered. The applicant is the owner of the car which was driven by the co-accused.
